d: The Supreme Court has raised serious questions over the deletion of 47.5 lakh names from Delhi’s voter list during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. The court has sought clarification from the Election Commission regarding data on voters classified as deceased or shifted. A key concern is whether the authorities have accurate figures to justify these deletions and how many voters have actually died or moved to another location.
